QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Into the Mine
QuestInfo.0: Ask Bavan if he's contacted Hiver yet.
QuestInfo.1: Hiver is waiting for you at the Mine? He must not think you're a threat. Hurry there!
QuestInfo.2: Hiver laid a trap for you! But a suspicious girl intervened in the mine. Go to Edelstein and confront Bavan!

0.0: #p1013203# told me to tell you to meet him over at the Mine. He's really busy, but he can spare a moment for a kid like you. I guess he really wants that 30 bucks.

no.0: Wh-why did you go through all that trouble? Whatever, I got my bear meat.

1.0: You should have known that was a trap! #p1013203#'s way too smart to fall for the old "I owe you 30 Mesos" routine!\r\n#L0# #bYeah, yeah. Either way, it worked. But who was that lady? She didn't look like a Black Wing!#l\n#k
1.1: She fell for that trap, just like you, so you could probably be friends. I wonder who she is...\r\n#L0# #b#p1013203# seems to have a lot of enemies. For now, I'd better return to #m310000000# and confront #p2152016#!#l\n#k
1.2: Yeah! Let's go roast him! I bet he'll act like he didn't know. That lady, though, she seemed so familiar...

npc.0: Haven't you gone to the Mine yet?
